title: Tomato, orange, cucumber & lemon blood-sugar drink
label: Videos row 2 · recipe talking head · phase 2 · Google Omni (Flow)
tool: 9 clips, one still each, edited in CapCut (word-by-word captions)

clips.dialogue: If you're terrified of diabetes, pay attention to this.
clips.still: Woman in a grey crewneck sweater behind a white marble counter, bright white kitchen with open shelves, holding a halved tomato in each palm toward camera
clips.action: Holds the two tomato halves out to camera while talking, then presses them together between both hands

clips.dialogue: You won't need expensive pills after this recipe.
clips.still: Close-up of one hand over the marble counter holding a tomato half, juice and seeds puddled on the marble below
clips.action: Squeezes the tomato half in one fist so juice and seeds drip onto the marble counter

clips.dialogue: Blend two tomatoes with the juice of two oranges,
clips.still: Same kitchen, empty glass blender jar on a steel base on the counter, lid beside it, two whole red tomatoes in her hands above the jar
clips.action: Drops two whole tomatoes into the blender jar, then rests her hands on the counter and talks to camera

clips.dialogue: then add one chopped cucumber and
clips.still: Blender jar with two tomatoes inside, she holds a small glass pitcher of orange juice over it
clips.action: Pours orange juice from the small glass pitcher into the blender jar over the tomatoes

clips.still: Blender jar with tomatoes and orange juice, she holds a small glass bowl of chopped cucumber over it
clips.action: Tips the glass bowl of chopped cucumber into the blender jar, then lifts the empty bowl away

clips.dialogue: Blend it all for a full minute until
clips.still: Blender jar full of tomato and cucumber, she holds half a lemon above it
clips.action: Squeezes the lemon half by hand into the blender jar

clips.still: She stands behind the filled blender, one hand on the base, lid on the counter
clips.action: Holds the blender base steady while it blends, looking at camera

clips.dialogue: This drink lowers blood sugar. It also helps the liver and helps reduce cholesterol.
clips.still: Blender jar of smooth red drink, a tall clear glass on the counter
clips.action: Pours the red drink from the blender jar into the tall glass, then holds the jar beside the full glass and talks to camera

clips.dialogue: If you want more remedies like this, save and share this video so I know you like it. Follow me so you don't miss the next one.
clips.still: Holding the half-full blender jar of red drink at chest height, full glass on the counter in front
clips.action: Holds the blender jar with both hands and talks warmly to camera
